sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

session_conflict.note: the event date carries the volume spike, so the market reacted on that date and the print was bmo. If tagged amc, the recorded move is the day-after give-back and may carry the wrong sign.

history.basis: 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times (exact); 75 earlier print(s) excluded as filed under a former name on this CIK before 2025-12-08

event_plausibility.reason: inferred cadence of 69 days is too short to be an earnings cadence (quarterly is ~91, semi-annual ~182), so the 5 matched filings are not earnings -- most likely monthly operational updates caught by the 6-K text matcher. No cadence verdict is possible and the reaction history above should not be used as an earnings base rate. Confirm the date from a company source instead.

options.event_implied_move_basis: straddle taken as-is (no vol anchor to net off)
options.skew_note: IV(25d put) - IV(25d call). Positive = the market is paying more for downside protection than for upside.
warnings: ATM legs not two-sided; no live bid/ask to price a straddle from

deadband_basis: half the median of 5 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
